vulnerability.name: GHSA-rgwj-5xj2-c3m3
vulnerability.description: MySQL2: Unbounded zlib inflate in compressed MySQL protocol handler allows decompression-bomb DoS

statements.impact_statement: mysql2 is present only as a devOptional transitive of the prisma CLI (backend/package-lock.json:7123 marks devOptional:true; parent at line 7925). Our Prisma datasource provider is postgresql (backend/prisma/schema.prisma:13), and no source file imports mysql2 (grep -rn 'mysql' backend/src backend/scripts returns 0 hits). The vulnerable code path is the compressed MySQL protocol handler in the driver, which requires establishing a MySQL connection to trigger — impossible in our setup, so the vulnerability is not on any execute path we ship or run.
